desc: Copper alloyEar Scoop, as identified by finder. Cast near-flat spoon with a tapering handle (other end lost), with an incised triangle on/in the bowl and horizontal hatching affording grip on the handle. A central dimple is impressed on the underside of the bowl, showing as a faint mark on the decorated side. Bent in the same plane. Suggested date: Roman, 40-400, though an Anglo-Saxon date is also possible, angular incised decoration being common to later Roman and Germanic metalwork.Length (as found): 42mm, Width (bowl): 8.1mm, Thickness: 2mm, Weight: 1.70gms.
